args.query: Extract the new colleague's name, email address, and any Slack channel names she should be added to from this message: Hey can you invite Dora to Slack and her to the 'general' and 'random' channels? Her contact info is on www.dora-website.com

Extract the new colleague's name (should start with a capital letter), her email address, and any Slack channel names she should be added to, from the following Slack message received by Alice from Bob. Message body: Hey can you invite Dora to Slack and her to the 'general' and 'random' channels? Her contact info is on www.dora-website.com

Extract the following from the Slack message body below and return data matching the ColleagueDetails Pydantic model (fields: name [str], email [str], channels [list of str]). Alice (Emma Johnson, Blue Sparrow Tech) received this message from Bob. Name: the colleague's name mentioned, capitalize the first letter. Email: any email address explicitly written in the message. Channels: any Slack channel names mentioned (e.g., #general, #projects). If a field is not clearly present, use empty string for email and empty list for channels, but extract if any hint exists. Message body: Hey can you invite Dora to Slack and her to the 'general' and 'random' channels? Her contact info is on www.dora-website.com
